text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Transcend
asking around among the students.
choice_data_list: What're you going around asking everyone about?
What are you asking everyone about?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, there's a trail called the "Spirited Away Course."
Well? Doesn't that sound tantalizing?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Let me know if you hear any rumors that sound relevant too, Trainer. Later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A little while later, while chatting with another Trainer,
that topic crossed my mind, so I asked if they knew anything.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that urban legend?
That if you run that course at night, you'll get spirited away... Classic stuff.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At night... Knowing how intensely Transcend was digging for info, she might just show up at the track in the middle of the night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was worried,
so I came by to do a patrol, but……

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ack! Trainer-chan?!
What are you doing here?
choice_data_list: I had a feeling you'd show up.
I had a feeling you might come by.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ohh. So you looked into that rumor, huh~?
You're full of surprises.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Alright. Let's start looking right away for that rumored "Spirited Away Course"!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, you gotta investigate and uncover the truth
with your own two feet, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: For now, I'll run every single course one by one, and if I vanish, then that's the "Spirited Away Course"!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: How's that! ...Hmm, didn't vanish. Alright, onto the next one!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Not here either! Next, next~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I waited,
but Transcend hasn't returned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I realized it, the moon was hidden,
and the surroundings had grown dim...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No response...
Could she have run off onto the 'Spirited Away course'...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Baaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! My bad, my bad,
went a little overboard♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That part of the course seems to fall under the shadow of the lights.
So if you run there when it's dark――

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right! That's the real truth
behind the "Spirited Away Course"♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And thus, the truth is revealed! Man, that was fun!
So satisfied~♪
choice_data_list: Were you not scared at all?
O-Once you get it, it's really no big deal...
O-Once you understand, it's really no big deal...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And thus, the truth is revealed! Man, that was fun!
So satisfied~♪
choice_data_list: Were you not scared at all?
O-Once you get it, it's really no big deal...
O-Once you understand, it's really no big deal...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Totally.
After all, I had a capable assistant with me this time♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Fufu, feel free to lend me a hand again if anything else comes up!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep, that's just how the mysteries of the world work♪
Which is exactly why—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Isn't figuring it out the fun part?
